dataset_name: Sentinel-2 Multi-Spectral Instrument (MSI) Level-2A Bottom-Of-Atmosphere Reflectance
access_method: Planetary Computer STAC API + Scene Classification Layer (SCL) cloud filtering
use_in_system: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), vegetation stress, and bare soil scarp tracking
